rot.ideia.ex1.e1: A trick to avoid calculating: the pawn's path to promotion is one side of a square.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: If the king can get into the square, it catches the pawn. If not, the pawn promotes.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: The black pawn's square has its corners on a5, e5, e1 and a1. Get into it with your king.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Get into the pawn's square, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The king got into the square and catches the pawn in time.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The king goes to e2, inside the square. From there it catches the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.f1e1.1: That catches it too! The e1 square is inside the square.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.f1e1.2: Look also at e2: the king enters the square and already moves towards the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f1g2.1: The king stayed outside the square.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f1g2.2: The pawn runs, and the king cannot catch it.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f1f2.1: The king stayed outside the square.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f1f2.2: The pawn runs, and the king cannot catch it.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f1g1.1: The king stayed outside the square.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.f1g1.2: The pawn runs, and the king cannot catch it.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Get into the pawn's square, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex1.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and get into the square.
rot.ideia.ex1.fins.coroa: The pawn promoted: the king did not arrive in time.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember: a king inside the square catches the pawn. And the square moves with the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Now the other way round: the pawn is yours. Its square has its corners on f4, b4, b8 and f8.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: The black king is on a8, outside the square. Your king need not help: run with the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Run with the pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: Exactly! The square shrank, and the black king is still outside it.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The pawn advances to f5. The black king cannot catch it.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1b2.1: The white king moved, and the pawn lost a move.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1b2.2: The black king gets into the square and catches the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a2.1: The white king moved, and the pawn lost a move.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a2.2: The black king gets into the square and catches the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1b1.1: The white king moved, and the pawn lost a move.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1b1.2: The black king gets into the square and catches the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Run with the pawn, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.fala: Play on from here against the machine and see what happens.
rot.ideia.ex2.livre.volta: Let's go back to the position and run with the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.fins.capturado: The black king caught the pawn. It is a draw.
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: When the king is outside the square, the pawn promotes on its own.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Careful: a pawn on its starting square can jump two squares. Count the square from the jump.
rot.ideia.ex2.l3: Now I will show the king that gets in and catches up, and how the turn changes everything.
rot.demos.alcanca.e1: The white king gets into the square. Watch it catch the pawn.
rot.demos.alcanca.l1: The king gets into the square.
rot.demos.alcanca.l3: The king follows, always inside the square.
rot.demos.alcanca.l8: The pawn promotes, but the new queen is next to the king.
rot.demos.alcanca.l9: The king captures the queen. It is a draw.
rot.demos.vez.e1: The same position, but Black is to move: the pawn moves before the king. The turn matters.
rot.demos.vez.l1: The pawn advances, and the square shrinks: now it runs from a4 to d1.
rot.demos.vez.l2: The white king is outside the new square.
rot.demos.vez.l7: The pawn promotes: the king was one step behind.
rot.demos.vez.l8: Now it's your turn: draw the square before you move.
rot.pratica.corrida.enunciado: As White: the pawn's square has corners on g3, b3, b8 and g8. The black king is outside: run.
rot.pratica.corrida.fim: Well done. Outside the square, the king cannot catch up.
rot.pratica.alcance.enunciado: As Black: your king is already in the pawn's square. Stay inside as it shrinks, and catch the pawn.
rot.pratica.alcance.fim: Perfect. Inside the square, the king caught the pawn.
